cards.name: Atmos Rewards Summit Visa Infinite
cards.notes: Not modeled: 3 points on rent paid through Bilt (3x), which applies only to purchases made through bilt. Not modeled: Atmos Rewards status points earned alongside the points (0.5 per dollar, Status points from spend). Not modeled: 10% bonus with an eligible Bank of America account (10% more on all earn, which depends on a banking relationship). Launched August 2025 with Atmos Rewards. The card also earns 3 points per dollar on foreign purchases, which no spend category can express yet, so it is not modeled as an earn rule. The issuer page lists Visa Infinite car rental perks (VIP amenities, status upgrades and discounts with Avis, Hertz and National) without a tier, and roadside assistance; these are not modeled.

cards.name: Bank of America Customized Cash Rewards credit card

earn.note: Choice options are groups, not single categories: gas and EV charging; online shopping including cable, internet, phone plans and streaming; dining; travel; drug stores and pharmacies; home improvement and furnishings.
Shares the $2,500 quarterly cap with the choice category; superstores do not count as grocery stores.
